title: Can I MASTER Chaturaji Chess?
summary: The creator plays chess.com Chaturaji: four players (Red, Blue, Yellow, Green) each get half an army in a corner of one 8x8 board and score points for captures. Placement awards: 1st = 3 wins, 2nd = 1 win, 3rd = 1 loss, 4th = 3 losses. Goal: 5 wins. Game 1 (Blue) he captures Yellow's king early, promotes pawns to boats and wins on checkmate points; game 2 has a 2100 opponent, and he finishes by claiming the victory while ahead, collecting the last three wins.
rules: 8x8 board, four players, each with a half army in its own corner: king, boat, knight, bishop + 4 pawns; each army advances toward a different side.
Turn order clockwise (Red, Blue, Yellow, Green on chess.com).
Boat moves exactly like a rook.
Pawns move one square only (no double step, 8:31) and promote only to a boat (2:38).
Capturing scores points: pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 5, boat 5, king 3 (on-screen values); checkmating a king scores 3 (5:09).
Pieces of an eliminated player remain on the board greyed out and can still be worth points (7:29-7:39).
A player far enough ahead can 'claim the victory' to end the game (11:40).
win_condition: Most points when the game ends (or claim win when ahead). Series goal: 5 wins net.
